function.name: get_weather
function.description: Get current weather or forecasts for a city. Call this tool for any question about the weather, temperature, rain, wind or forecasts. Typical questions: 'what's the weather like?', 'what's the weather in Geneva?', 'is it going to rain?', 'tomorrow's forecast'. If no city is mentioned, use Geneva by default.

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search for information on the Internet via DuckDuckGo. Use when the question is about a person, place, event or uncertain fact. Typical questions: 'who is [person]?', 'what is [concept]?', 'where is [place]?'. Do not use for weather or home automation commands.

query.description: Subject to search. E.g.: 'Steve Jobs', 'capital of Japan'.

function.name: get_ha_state
function.description: Read the current state of a device or sensor in Home Assistant. Use for any question about the home state: temperature, humidity, lights on/off, shutters open/closed, power consumption, presence, sensors. Typical questions: 'what is the outside temperature?', 'is the living room light on?', 'what is the humidity level?'. Do not use for commands (turn on, turn off, open) or Internet weather.

entity_id.description: Home Assistant entity ID. Examples: 'sensor.temperature_exterieure', 'light.lampe_salon', 'climate.thermostat'. If unknown, use an approximate name — fuzzy match enabled.
